description.text: AI-written synthesis of the official page retrieved in this pass, prepared by the collecting assistant: Camp | Betaworks Camp About Previous Camps AI Camp: Agent Systems AI Camp: Interfaces AI Camp: App Layer AI Camp: Native Applications Apply Companies Team Events Writing News Connect Deadline Extended! Apply to AI Camp Application now open for AI Camp: The New Agent Economy. Apply Now . The next Camp application will open soon, submit your project for early consideration here . A thematic investment and in-residence program for startups building in frontier technologies. Camp takes place twice annually. The Spring session runs March through May (applications open Dec - Jan). The Fall session runs August through November (applications open June - July). NEXT CAMP: Fall 2025 We're looking for early-stage startups that are rethinking the human-machine boundary through new interface paradigms: voice-native tools, ambient agents, novel input/output flows, multi-modal or invisible interfaces, sophisticated prompt-based interactions. We want to see products with a strong opinion, that treat the interface as fundamental. No application form was opened, and this record does not add a deadline, investment instrument, or eligibility rule beyond that quoted text.
